scope: Manual reading of all nine installed WAGO bodies from the complete final native assembly against every other non-wire body, including tubes, their actual printed hosts and all other WAGOs. Each selected wire-mouth approach and current PSU driver column is tested in the same full physical scene. Nominal reference envelopes and digital insertion/clearance only; no physical lever-force claim.

wago-h.purpose: C14 live / PSU primary / relay 1 COM

wago-g.purpose: C14 PE / carbonator bond / compressor earth

wago-sensors.purpose: PCB J4 / temperature bus / flow meter common

wago-v12.purpose: PSU secondary / relay 2 COM / PCB J10 V12

wago-gnd.purpose: PSU secondary / pump negative / PCB J10 GND

wago-reeds-b.purpose: PCB J7 / reservoir B / carbonator reed common

wago-mana.purpose: J1 valve common and eight A-H coil branches

wago-manb.purpose: J2 valve common, I/J/K coils and condenser fan

wire_entry_context: Conservative straight D3 approach probes are context only. Actual source-bound curved conductors are clear of larger bodies in the complete final production model. Wire-to-tube contacts are excluded.

current_parent_binding.scope: All nine junction bodies and poses are identical to the native reading. The only subsequent host change removes front-top stock at the lever mouths, so cannot add a body or driver obstruction. The completed physical assembly and wire integration retain all other measured members.

current_lever_access.scope: Manual conservative 6.85 mm lever-swing envelopes over the complete front half of all nine mounted WAGOs. Test each on its populated removable parent with the other parents separated on the bench. The rear junctions are wired before back-top is closed over the cold core. Conductors are dressed afterward.

cold-core: Disconnect the removable V-B return before operating the core junction levers.
back-top: Separate back-top from the cold core before wiring the rear junctions.

current_neutral_closing_motion.scope: Complete 300 mm rear closing interval of the neutral WAGO and every actual added host surface against the retained cold core. The front lever fix removes stock only and creates no new closing obstruction.
